ns2:course.label: Senior Thesis
ns2:course.description: Completion of the research project begun under ECE 497. Preparation and oral presentation of a written thesis that reports the results of the project. 2 undergraduate hours. To fulfill the Advanced Composition Requirement, credit must be earned for both ECE 497 and ECE 499. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: ECE 497 and consent of instructor.
